title: Surreal Pixelated Muse
description: A central humanoid figure with a pixelated metallic body, green butterfly wings, and a melting face stands in a surreal dreamscape. The scene is filled with melting clocks, floating eyeballs, jellyfish, golden city pathways, draped fabrics, and apples against a dark cosmic background with dripping orange and black liquid from the top.
prompt: A surreal dreamscape featuring a tall humanoid figure with a pixelated chrome body covered in colorful flowers, large translucent green butterfly wings, and a melting face with one glowing green eye. The figure raises one hand dramatically. Surrounding elements include melting Dali-style clocks, floating eyeballs, bioluminescent jellyfish, golden pathways leading to a futuristic city in a mirror portal, draped grey fabric over stone ruins, red and silver apples, with black and orange liquid dripping from the top of the frame in a dark cosmic atmosphere.
